_comment: Guided tour for the Burst Browser. Each step points at a real control (its name is the key the app remembers the control's rectangle under) and the action steps wait for the user to use it. Read by chisurf.emtk.help_guide and chisurf.gui.widgets.tools.guided_tour.

steps.title: Open the bursts
steps.text: Open Folder reads every .bur table under a burstwise analysis folder, with the per-burst companions beside it. A single .bur file or a .pto container goes through Open File.

await.hint: Press Open Folder and choose a folder with .bur files.

steps.title: Which detector
steps.text: Burst tables carry photon counts per detector group. Pick the group the columns refer to; All uses the whole-burst columns.

steps.title: One column at a time
steps.text: The histogram shows one column of the table. E shows the FRET populations; S separates donor-only bursts (S near 1) from doubly labelled ones.

steps.title: Gates
steps.text: The gates keep the bursts inside an E, S and size range; the table, the histogram and the status line follow at once. Lower the S maximum to drop the donor-only bursts.

steps.title: A gate in one press
steps.text: A region preset sets the E gate in one press. Drag the button onto the histogram to apply it there.

steps.title: The bursts that pass
steps.text: Each row is a burst that passes the gates. Click rows to select them; Use table selection for hist histograms only the selected ones.

steps.title: Gate on the plot
steps.text: With E or S plotted, the shaded band is the gate: drag its edges and the gates follow.

steps.title: Take them with you
steps.text: Export gated bursts writes every burst that passes the gates as CSV; Export selected bursts only the selected rows that also pass them.
